text:
jamal: thinking about a clearer 'ceiling / floor' semantics for hosting modes so adapters and SDKs can reason about feature availability. my brain dump: floor = minimal contract all modes must satisfy (auth, simple sync generation, model pinning, basic metrics). ceiling = mode-specific extras (local KMS, GPU-burst, low-latency regional routing). want to decide what falls back vs hard-error.
sophia: +1 on the concept. we should explicitly mark which features may degrade gracefully vs which must return error. e.g., kv-cache can degrade to cold-path, but kms unavailability probably needs a hard error in private. :thinking:
alex: fwiw we had a P0 where private-sidecar lacked streaming support and callers got weird hangs. that suggests streaming either belongs in floor or we provide a shim that denies/queues quickly. shim cost needs to be quantified.
irene: propose capability negotiation at handshake time: client sends requested features, adapter replies with granted_features bitmask + fallback_hint. simple proto: `handshake { request_id, features[], meta { region, tenant_id } }` and response: `granted:[], denied:[], fallback_hint:"string"`. that keeps callsite explicit.
jamal: nice. exact handshake shape we can use in SDKs. example:
```
// client -> adapter
handshake {
  request_id: "r-123",
  features: ["streaming","kvcache","kms"],
  meta: { region: "eu-west-1", tenant_id: "acme" }
}
// adapter -> client
handshake_response {
  granted: ["streaming","kvcache"],
  denied: ["kms"],
  fallback_hint: "use-hosted-kms-proxy"
}
```
sophia: make sure traces/metrics record `capability_source` and whether fallback was used. we need sliceability for post-deploy regressions (e.g., increased latency when using shim). :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary started: adapter-handshake-v2 -> dedicated/us-west-2 (50 pods) :boat:
alex: rollout thoughts: 2-week canary with opt-in flag for Dedicated tenants. update SDK to surface `granted_features` so apps can adapt (and log events). also add a server-side enforcement layer that rejects disallowed ceilings for non-entitled tokens.
irene: compatibility: older SDKs won't do handshake. plan: default to floor-only behavior when handshake absent and emit a metric `handshake_missing`. also include `compat_mode: legacy` in traces so we can measure impact.
jamal: billing/security note: some ceilings (gpu-burst, private-kms) have billing/entitlement constraints. handshake must include token scopes and adapter should validate before granting. if a tenant attempts a ceiling without entitlement, adapter returns denied + suggested plan (e.g., upgrade link).
sophia: ops/runbook: add explicit error codes: FALLBACK_OK (app can continue), FALLBACK_WARN (degraded perf), FALLBACK_REJECT (hard error). tie those to SLOs and alerting rules. i'll draft the runbook and the test matrix.
alex: i'll draft the test matrix (cross-mode permutations, legacy SDKs, throttling under cache-miss, kms failures). will also add a small chaos test: disable streaming in dedicated sidecar and ensure client sees DENIED w/ fallback_hint quickly. :thumbsup:
jamal: i'll own SDK surface + server adapter changes. ETA: end of next sprint for canary-ready PRs. thanks all — will watch deploy metrics and create the RFC with proto defs and runbook link.
